fixed.summary: A whitespace-only text beside an element on one line, such as `<View> <Text>x</Text></View>`, no longer aborts the TSX compile: outside a Text it makes no node, inside a Text it stays text, and any compiler panic now comes back as a compile error.

A game's `og check` reads the ui module from its declaration (types/ui.d.ts) instead of the engine's web sources, so a game without the DOM library no longer reports the engine's own DOM and TextEncoder errors.
A component's `import "./x.en.ogt"` type-checks: the engine's types declare `*.ogt` modules.
